title: Memento Pattern
overview: Capture and restore an object's internal state without violating encapsulation.
useCases: You want to save snapshots/checkpoints of an object's state
You need to restore an object to an earlier state without exposing or modifying its internal fields directly
exampleUses: A version control system that stores a snapshot of the working tree at each commit so the user can check out any earlier revision
A game that saves a checkpoint before a boss fight so the player can retry from that point without starting over
A form wizard that saves the user's answers at each step so they can navigate back and change earlier responses without losing later ones
